This workflow captures the Day 78 deliverable as structured fields in the **Client Acquisition Kit Fields** node (run it once with Manual Trigger to see the values), plus a fully worked model answer in the sticky note to the right that you can read directly on the canvas.

## Model Answer: Client Acquisition Review

### One-Page Client Acquisition Kit

- **Niche:** HVAC & Home Services Contractors
- **Pain point:** Missed calls and slow lead follow-up cost 15-20% of potential jobs
- **Pricing (Day 73):** Starter $600-900 | Growth $1,800-2,800 + $350-500/mo | Pro $3,500+ + $800-1,200/mo
- **Portfolio proof piece:** Missed-Call Text-Back workflow — before/after: 0% to ~15% callback recovery (training-project numbers, honestly labeled)
- **Outreach template (Day 75):** subject "Quick question about [Company]'s after-hours call handling" / hook / value prop / CTA

**EXAMPLES reference:** `WEEK_11_CLIENT_ACQUISITION/EXAMPLES/client_acquisition_automation_system.json` imported into n8n and re-run successfully as proof of build capability.

**Real outreach sent today:** 3 real contacts (a former colleague, a home-services owner in the target niche, and a warm LinkedIn connection) received the Day 75 email — real send, not hypothetical.

|---|---|---|---|
| Former colleague (referral source) | Today | No reply yet (< 48 hrs) | Follow-up 1 in 3 days |
| Coastal Air HVAC (real prospect) | Today | No reply yet | Follow-up 1 in 3 days |
